S.FORM: bangcalay a tatayna atu l'causay a aadupan (kamu nu Hulam: 美女與野獸) kakungkuan a kawaw . yumahida sa, idaw ku mabataday nu kanatal idaw ku cacaya a talahaday mabawbaway ku balucu makatalay a Ya-tan wan-ce . idaw ku cacayay a demiad salabi sa maudad tabaki ku bali, idaw ku cacaya a micidekay ku la'cus a babalaki tayni itniyi i cen-paw , mangalay tuna nikapetan tu bangcalay a sicekaay a balu mangalay miliyun tu sapilabinaw ci wan-ceanan, nika ci wan-ce macikien la'cusen cinidaan bahbah han ni wance kiya babalaki, edep hantu nida ku pana', ya la'cusay a babalaki alaw masumad mala bangcalay a sian-niw . . ci sian-niw hantu mangalay mibakin tina talahaday a wan-ce mala lacusay a mapaydangay a aadupan, cen-paw nu tademaw mala sakaudip nu cancanan atu tatakalan, pabali han nida tu dadingu' atu caaya ka cebal nu sicekaay a balu sipabeli ci wan-cean. idasa ci wan-ce i sadikuday nu nikapecaan nu balu amahetik sa amatineng tunu tademawan, satimaan han ala amalawpes, anunayi ku sakalawpes, nika udip nida hidasatu malapaydangay nu aadupan. Be-el , cacaysa itida i Fa-kuo nu adidi'ay a niyadu manamuh mibelihay tu cudad a limucedan, sisa ci Be-el hina libut tina niyaduan caaya kasumad kuni kaudipan, mangalay pasayda i cudad mikilim tu balihenaway a sakaudip. mikihida tu niyaduay a limuceda, hinacudaday icudad ci Be-el kaisa ku katuuday milihida cinidaan, caay katapa ku mapelukay a cacabayan. wama ni Be-el ci Mu-wey-se (Mo-wey-se, 莫維斯) u sitangahay matinengay mikinkiw tu cancanan a kawawan, sawni mikinkiw tu cancanan caay ka laheci kuni kinkiwan tu tuud katawantu nu niyaduay a tademaw u maapaay han cinida. mangalay cinida milihida tu sapisetset tuni kinkiw nida tu tiyun hannanay malineng tu ku sapiletek tu kasuy a kikayan, alaen nida ku nikinkiwan tu masangaay malingad tayda i sakasetsetan a dadan mungangaw ku culil, manglay cinida miliyas tuni lalabaan nu kuyu a wacu pacebasatu micumud i cenpaw micaliw milabin. ci l'causay a aadupan maadih nida ku caaya kaw kaka tinengan a tademaw micumud mapatay nu linges, pulul hantu nida ci Mu-wey-se (Mo-wey-se, 莫維斯) i papululan. 同時加斯頓(Gaston)和來富(Lefou), . tawya ci Ka-se-tun (Gaston, 加斯頓) atu ci Lefou , kanamuhan nu niyaduay a tademaw, pabalucu pasayda i niyaduay u sabangcalay a limucedan ci Be-el mikikun kitasa. kaiyan ni Be-el ku ngalay sananay a tademaw, tabaki masatatama'ay ci Ka-se-tun (Gaston, 加斯頓). maadih ni Be-el ci subayu—Fi-li-pe sacacay sa taluma caay nayi maadih nida ku wama, kacaw satu cinida ci Fi-li-pe pasayda i cen-paw mikilim. mangalay miala ci Be-el ci yamaan nida hidasatu milabin. tawya a labii miyukiw ci paydangan a aadupan ci Be-el an mapulung kita malabisa, kaiyan ni Be-el , ci paydangan a aadupan mapatay nu linges, sakamusa i katuuday amana' pakani ku katuuday tu cancanan. (Lumiere),時鐘－葛士華(Cogsworth),茶壺－茶煲太太(Mrs. Potts) . teban nulabii mapateluh ci Be-el taydan nina i paladah mikilim tu kakanen, amica kunipihapu ni paydangan a aadupan tu nakamuan, nika aenengan nu lacik — Lu-mi-er (Lumiere 盧米亞), tuki – Ke-se-hwa (Cogsworth 葛士華), tiwi – O-cia bai (Mrs. Potts 茶煲太大), atu kupu — A-ci , manamuh tu kataydaan nida mapalaw ku katuuday paadih tui takalay a kakanen cinidaan. katuuday a tademaw mangalay papilabin ci Be-el mangalay papilawpes tu tatimaan. namamin satu namalabi ci Lumiere atu ci Cogsworth ladayen nuheni ci Be-el miadih tu cenpaw, hina paawpaaway ci Be-el litawalan nida kiya tatusay haymaw hannida micumud miubiy taydan nida i pabaw mibuhat tu kakabian. kalapecipecian kiya kakabian u kakabian ni paydangan a aadupan, ci paydangan a aadupan makaadih tuni cumudan ni Be-el mapatay nu linges bahbahantu nida ci Be-el . matawid ci Be-el caay pakahemhem tunabalucuan ci paydangan a aadupan tu ni kaynah, kanahatu u teban nulabii, kacawan nida ku subayu ci Fi-li-pe milaliw. idadan henay lalabaen nu kuyu a wacu, kakalahan satu ci paydangan a aadupan katukuh sa bahbahen nida kiya kuyu a wacu namim, nika ci paydangan a aadupan hida satu maduka mabulilah, ahican tu kiya haw pataluma' hantu ni Be-el i cenpaw lihida satu mikukay ci paydangan a aadupan. ci Mo-wey-se taluma' satu i niyadu' pasayda ci Gaston miawaw pakaudipen kakusa, nika inai ku palutatengaay ci Mo-wey-se nakamuan a paydangan a aadupan, micili cinidaan u maapaay kisu han ba'ba'hen naca cinida i kakanen. paydangan a aadupan maduka satu sadimelen ni Be-el amidiput, maadih cinida tuni kacaay ka lipahak ni Be-el ngalay saca mangalay mipadang tuci Be-el an aw hica ku papadangan numaku sa, pabali hantu nida tu cenpaw aadihan tu cuda ci Be-el mala sinubu nida. sademiad sa kunuheni maladay, paydangan a aadupan hamaw satu masumad ku balucu, ci Be-el makaadih tunika sumadan ni paydangan a aadupan tu kapah hamaw satu manamuh cinidaan. lipahak namim namapalaw, paydangan a aadupan palita hanida ci Be-el kiya makenud ku bihid numisu han, sakamusatu ci Be-el mabulah kaku ci amaan numaku, paydangan a aadupan pacaliw hantu nida ci Be-el tu dadingu, ci Be-el i dadingu maka makaadih tui dadinguay a babalaki ci amaaku mabulilah tuni kataynian tuni kangalayan miala i takuwanay aidadan. manamuhay ci Be-el an a paydangan a aadupan caay kalesen makaadih tuni ka lalum ni Be-el , pabalucu satu pakalihalay, lalitumuh satu kunuheni maluwama, sipabeli hantu nida ku dadingu cinidaan. i cenpaway a katuuday a tademaw kaisa makaadih tu pahedekan amalalum. . tawya ci Gaston mangalay makaala ci Be-el an, cakayan nida ku maapaay a sakakaay, palulen nida ci Mo-wey-se u maapaay han a ngangan ku sapulul cinidaan , patalawan nida ci Be-el mangalay pakasi acawa cinidaan. pacudaden nida tuni kacaay kaapa ni ama aku, pacudaden nida tu tatengaay kawaw, ci Be-el patahekalen nida ku dadingu paadih ci paydangan a aadupan tu tatengay nu nabalucuan nida pakatineng tu katuuday a palutatengan. ci Gaston makaadih ci Be-el an miadih ci paydangan a aadupan tu wayway nida sasa mainapsa, sakamuen nida ku katuuday a tademaw tuci paydangan a aadupan a sapakatalawan, miwuywuy tu niyaduay a tademaw atayda mipatay ci paydangan a aadupan, pululen nida ci Be-el atu ci Mo-wey-se tangeden i sasa nu luma'. ci O-cia bai a wawa nida ci A-ci hamawsa micumud i tisagi ni Be-el makatukuh i luma' ni Be-el , maadih nida ku kawaw namakayda miala cinida tu sakalihalay nu dinki a sapiletek tu kasuy a kikay sa mapatahekal ci Be-el . namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan

Be-el , cacaysa itida i Fa-kuo nu adidi'ay a niyadu manamuh mibelihay tu cudad a limucedan, sisa ci Be-el hina libut tina niyaduan caaya kasumad kuni kaudipan, mangalay pasayda i cudad mikilim tu balihenaway a sakaudip. mikihida tu niyaduay a limuceda, hinacudaday icudad ci Be-el kaisa ku katuuday milihida cinidaan, caay katapa ku mapelukay a cacabayan. wama ni Be-el ci Mu-wey-se (Mo-wey-se, 莫維斯) u sitangahay matinengay mikinkiw tu cancanan a kawawan, sawni mikinkiw tu cancanan caay ka laheci kuni kinkiwan tu tuud katawantu nu niyaduay a tademaw u maapaay han cinida. mangalay cinida milihida tu sapisetset tuni kinkiw nida tu tiyun hannanay malineng tu ku sapiletek tu kasuy a kikayan, alaen nida ku nikinkiwan tu masangaay malingad tayda i sakasetsetan a dadan mungangaw ku culil, manglay cinida miliyas tuni lalabaan nu kuyu a wacu pacebasatu micumud i cenpaw micaliw milabin. ci l'causay a aadupan maadih nida ku caaya kaw kaka tinengan a tademaw micumud mapatay nu linges, pulul hantu nida ci Mu-wey-se (Mo-wey-se, 莫維斯) i papululan. 同時加斯頓(Gaston)和來富(Lefou), . tawya ci Ka-se-tun (Gaston, 加斯頓) atu ci Lefou , kanamuhan nu niyaduay a tademaw, pabalucu pasayda i niyaduay u sabangcalay a limucedan ci Be-el mikikun kitasa. kaiyan ni Be-el ku ngalay sananay a tademaw, tabaki masatatama'ay ci Ka-se-tun (Gaston, 加斯頓). maadih ni Be-el ci subayu—Fi-li-pe sacacay sa taluma caay nayi maadih nida ku wama, kacaw satu cinida ci Fi-li-pe pasayda i cen-paw mikilim. mangalay miala ci Be-el ci yamaan nida hidasatu milabin. tawya a labii miyukiw ci paydangan a aadupan ci Be-el an mapulung kita malabisa, kaiyan ni Be-el , ci paydangan a aadupan mapatay nu linges, sakamusa i katuuday amana' pakani ku katuuday tu cancanan. (Lumiere),時鐘－葛士華(Cogsworth),茶壺－茶煲太太(Mrs. Potts) . teban nulabii mapateluh ci Be-el taydan nina i paladah mikilim tu kakanen, amica kunipihapu ni paydangan a aadupan tu nakamuan, nika aenengan nu lacik — Lu-mi-er (Lumiere 盧米亞), tuki – Ke-se-hwa (Cogsworth 葛士華), tiwi – O-cia bai (Mrs. Potts 茶煲太大), atu kupu — A-ci , manamuh tu kataydaan nida mapalaw ku katuuday paadih tui takalay a kakanen cinidaan. katuuday a tademaw mangalay papilabin ci Be-el mangalay papilawpes tu tatimaan. namamin satu namalabi ci Lumiere atu ci Cogsworth ladayen nuheni ci Be-el miadih tu cenpaw, hina paawpaaway ci Be-el litawalan nida kiya tatusay haymaw hannida micumud miubiy taydan nida i pabaw mibuhat tu kakabian. kalapecipecian kiya kakabian u kakabian ni paydangan a aadupan, ci paydangan a aadupan makaadih tuni cumudan ni Be-el mapatay nu linges bahbahantu nida ci Be-el . matawid ci Be-el caay pakahemhem tunabalucuan ci paydangan a aadupan tu ni kaynah, kanahatu u teban nulabii, kacawan nida ku subayu ci Fi-li-pe milaliw. idadan henay lalabaen nu kuyu a wacu, kakalahan satu ci paydangan a aadupan katukuh sa bahbahen nida kiya kuyu a wacu namim, nika ci paydangan a aadupan hida satu maduka mabulilah, ahican tu kiya haw pataluma' hantu ni Be-el i cenpaw lihida satu mikukay ci paydangan a aadupan. ci Mo-wey-se taluma' satu i niyadu' pasayda ci Gaston miawaw pakaudipen kakusa, nika inai ku palutatengaay ci Mo-wey-se nakamuan a paydangan a aadupan, micili cinidaan u maapaay kisu han ba'ba'hen naca cinida i kakanen. paydangan a aadupan maduka satu sadimelen ni Be-el amidiput, maadih cinida tuni kacaay ka lipahak ni Be-el ngalay saca mangalay mipadang tuci Be-el an aw hica ku papadangan numaku sa, pabali hantu nida tu cenpaw aadihan tu cuda ci Be-el mala sinubu nida. sademiad sa kunuheni maladay, paydangan a aadupan hamaw satu masumad ku balucu, ci Be-el makaadih tunika sumadan ni paydangan a aadupan tu kapah hamaw satu manamuh cinidaan. lipahak namim namapalaw, paydangan a aadupan palita hanida ci Be-el kiya makenud ku bihid numisu han, sakamusatu ci Be-el mabulah kaku ci amaan numaku, paydangan a aadupan pacaliw hantu nida ci Be-el tu dadingu, ci Be-el i dadingu maka makaadih tui dadinguay a babalaki ci amaaku mabulilah tuni kataynian tuni kangalayan miala i takuwanay aidadan. manamuhay ci Be-el an a paydangan a aadupan caay kalesen makaadih tuni ka lalum ni Be-el , pabalucu satu pakalihalay, lalitumuh satu kunuheni maluwama, sipabeli hantu nida ku dadingu cinidaan. i cenpaway a katuuday a tademaw kaisa makaadih tu pahedekan amalalum. . tawya ci Gaston mangalay makaala ci Be-el an, cakayan nida ku maapaay a sakakaay, palulen nida ci Mo-wey-se u maapaay han a ngangan ku sapulul cinidaan , patalawan nida ci Be-el mangalay pakasi acawa cinidaan. pacudaden nida tuni kacaay kaapa ni ama aku, pacudaden nida tu tatengaay kawaw, ci Be-el patahekalen nida ku dadingu paadih ci paydangan a aadupan tu tatengay nu nabalucuan nida pakatineng tu katuuday a palutatengan. ci Gaston makaadih ci Be-el an miadih ci paydangan a aadupan tu wayway nida sasa mainapsa, sakamuen nida ku katuuday a tademaw tuci paydangan a aadupan a sapakatalawan, miwuywuy tu niyaduay a tademaw atayda mipatay ci paydangan a aadupan, pululen nida ci Be-el atu ci Mo-wey-se tangeden i sasa nu luma'. ci O-cia bai a wawa nida ci A-ci hamawsa micumud i tisagi ni Be-el makatukuh i luma' ni Be-el , maadih nida ku kawaw namakayda miala cinida tu sakalihalay nu dinki a sapiletek tu kasuy a kikay sa mapatahekal ci Be-el . namakayniay a nasulitan nasakamuan atu natinengan
